error: The data could not be loaded.
audit_note_required_help: A note for the audit log is required to delete.
denied_body: You do not have permission for this page.
coming_body: This part of the console is not ready yet.
mfa_body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
mfa_wrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Please try a new one.
enrol_body: To use the console you need an authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Scan the QR code or enter the key.
enrol_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
timeout_body: Your session has expired. The page stays open and unsaved changes are kept.
mfa_lost: Lost your device? Ask another admin to reset your verification, then set it up again.
backup_body: Add a second device or authenticator app. If you lose the first one, you can sign in with it.
backup_done: Your backup authenticator is set up.
ads_image_help: 4:3 ratio, at least 1200 × 900 pixels, JPG or PNG up to 500 KB.
ads_alt_help: Describe what is in the image for people using a screen reader. Do not repeat the title. 5 to 140 characters.
ads_cta_help_required: Required for each language. Up to 24 characters.
ads_link_help: Must start with https://. It opens in a new tab, and clicks are counted through our redirect.
ads_exclusive_help: No other ads will run in this slot and these regions during the same dates.
ads_err_alt_length: The image description should have 5 to 140 characters.
ads_err_link: The link must start with https://.
ads_err_image: The image must be 4:3, at least 1200 × 900 pixels, and a JPG or PNG up to 500 KB.
ads_err_overlap: This slot is already reserved for another ad in these dates: {title}.
ads_err_dates: The end must be after the start.
ads_err_slots: Choose at least one ad slot.
ads_err_blocked: Ads may not sell, give away or rehome animals. Change the wording.
ads_chart_alt: Chart of impressions and clicks per day. The data is in the table below.
ads_method: We count impressions and clicks in our own database, in aggregate and without cookies. An impression means the ad was rendered on screen; we do not measure viewability.
ads_upload_failed: The image could not be uploaded. Please try again.
ads_end_body: The ad stops showing straight away. Its statistics are kept.
ads_delete_body: The ad is removed from the list; its statistics and history are kept.
ads_ended_note: This ad has ended and cannot be edited. You can duplicate it.
house_body: They show when no paid ad fits a slot.
house_locked: Slots and targeting are fixed for house ads.

directory.title: Shelter directory
directory.live_note: Changes go live on the public pages and in the app as soon as you save.
directory.reminder: Yearly check: {count, plural, one {# entry has} other {# entries have}} not been checked for more than 12 months.
directory.field_source_help: Where the details come from, for example "shelter website" or "call to the shelter".
directory.saved: Saved and logged. Already live in the app.
directory.error_phone: This phone number is not valid. Enter it like 01 234 56 78.
directory.error_source: Enter where the details come from.
directory.error_hours: The closing time must be after the opening time.
directory.conflict: Someone else edited this shelter in the meantime. Refresh and enter your changes again.
directory.municipality_help: Without a confirmed shelter, the public pages tell people to call the municipality.
directory.history_restored: Version restored as a new change.
directory.import_drop: Drag a CSV file here or
directory.import_summary: {new, plural, one {# new entry} other {# new entries}}, {changed} changed, {removed} removed, {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}
directory.import_apply_blocked: Fix the errors in the file and upload it again first.
directory.delete_refused: You cannot delete this shelter because it serves {count, plural, one {# municipality} other {# municipalities}}. Assign them to another shelter first.
directory.delete_body: The shelter disappears from the public pages and the call buttons. The deletion will be recorded in the audit log.
